review.method: Questions, reference answers, pages, and relevant chunks were manually compared with the official University of Leeds PDF and the deterministic Stage 02 chunks.

questions.question: Where should I go in Student Services to begin updating my address?
questions.answer_reference: Open Personal Information in Student Services.

questions.question: Which option displays my current addresses and telephone numbers?
What should I click to edit an existing emergency, permanent home, or term-time address?
questions.answer_reference: Click Current next to the relevant address.

questions.question: What should I do if the address type I need is not shown?
questions.answer_reference: Select the address type from the dropdown list and click Submit.

questions.question: Should I copy the addresses and telephone numbers shown in the guide's examples?
questions.answer_reference: No. The examples are fictional and should not be copied.

questions.question: How many characters should I type when searching for an address or postal code?
How is an address filled in when my country appears in the country list?
questions.answer_reference: Select the country, search for the address, and click the correct result to fill the fields automatically; the fields can then be adjusted manually.

questions.question: How do I enter my address if my country is not available in the dropdown menu?
questions.answer_reference: Enter the address manually in the provided fields.

questions.question: Where should I enter my primary telephone number, and can I add more numbers?
questions.answer_reference: Enter it in Main Contact Number; additional numbers can be added if necessary.

questions.question: How do I save my updated address and contact details?
questions.answer_reference: Click Submit at the bottom of the page; the main page should then display the changes.
